# Municipal Ordinance No. 002, Series of 1993

**An Ordinance Providing for the Granting of Franchise for Motorized Passenger Tricycle in Accordance with [[Sec-447-RA7160|Section 447]] (3) (VI) of [[RA-7160|R.A. 7160]], Otherwise Known as the New Local Government Code (Franchising Ordinance of Motorized Passenger Tricycle in the Municipality of Pitogo)**

## Summary

This ordinance establishes the franchising system for motorized passenger tricycles in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], in accordance with [[Sec-447-RA7160|Section 447]] (3) (VI) of [[RA-7160|RA 7160]]. It creates a Tricycle Franchising Regulatory Committee with the sole power and authority to grant franchises, sets application requirements, prescribes fees, and establishes a renewable two-year franchise period.

## Key Provisions

**Section I — Title.** Known as the Franchising Ordinance of Motorized Passenger Tricycle in the Municipality of Pitogo.

**Section II — Tricycle Franchising Regulatory Committee.** A Tricycle Franchising Regulatory Committee is hereby created, composed of the Municipal Treasurer and three (3) members of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]]. The Chairman shall be anyone from the members of the Sangguniang Bayan.

**Section III — Committee Powers.** The Tricycle Franchising Regulatory Committee has the sole power and authority to grant franchise. Arguments in the granting of said franchise may be appealed to the Municipal Mayor.

**Section IV — Mayor's Permit.** All operators of passenger motorized tricycle in the Municipality of Pitogo shall secure a Mayor's Permit before operating said passenger motorized tricycle.

**Section V — Franchise Eligibility.** Only certified residents and Filipino citizens of the Municipality of Pitogo awarded a franchise may operate a passenger motorized tricycle, renewable every two (2) years.

**Section VI — Application Process.** To secure a franchise, the registered operator must first file an application with the Tricycle Franchising Regulatory Committee who shall furnish the applicant with the necessary application forms.

**Section VII — Required Documents.** The operator shall furnish the Franchising Regulatory Committee a certificate of registration of his tricycle from the LTO, a copy of the official receipt verifying payment of the registration fee.

**Section VIII — Additional Requirements.** The applicant shall produce a barangay clearance signed by the Barangay Captain verifying good moral character, a medical certificate from the government physician, copy of the insurance of the motorized tricycle, and a certificate from an authorized representative that the motorized tricycle is "road worthy."

**Section IX — Fees.** Upon filing, the applicant shall pay to the Treasurer of the Municipality the following:
- (a) Filing fee of One Hundred Fifty Pesos (P 150.00) per unit
- (b) Legal Research Fund fee of Ten Pesos (P 10.00)
- (c) Certification Fee of Ten Pesos (P 10.00)

**Section X — Annual Payments.** The applicant or franchise holder shall likewise pay annually before the 20th day of January the amount of Sixty Pesos (P 60.00) as Mayor's Permit Fee and Forty Pesos (P 40.00) as Supervision Fee before September 30 of every year.

**Section XI — Penalty for Late Payment.** Failure to pay the above fees before the deadline set in the preceding section shall be penalized by fifty percent (50%) penalty in addition to the amount to be paid.

**Section XII — Effectivity.** This ordinance shall take effect upon approval.
